title: Don't Miss the Final Month of the Sandwich Flea Market's 2025 Season - NewsBreak
text:
5 hours ago If you love discovering unique finds and hidden gems, then don't miss the final chance this season to visit Cape Cod’s beloved flea market! Photo by The Sandwich Flea Market If you love discovering unique finds and hidden gems, then don't miss the final chance this season to visit Cape Cod’s beloved flea market, the Sandwich Flea Market, also known as the Sandwich Bazaar! The market is set to offer treasure hunters and casual browsers alike an abundance of unique finds throughout October, which marks the last month of the 2025 season. Scheduled for every Wednesday and Sunday in October until the 26th, this popular Cape Cod flea market continues its tradition of bringing together vendors offering everything from vintage jewelry to military memorabilia.
Hosted at Oakcrest Cove at #34 Quaker Meeting House Road in Sandwich, Massachusetts, the market welcomes visitors with free admission. The market will be held on Wednesdays from 6 AM until noon (October 1st, October 8th, October 15th, October 22nd) and Sundays from 7 AM until noon (October 5th, October 12th, October 19th, October 26th). Visitors can expect to explore new items every week, including antiques, collectibles, tools, toys, books, movies, garden supplies, nautical items, coins, and sports memorabilia.
The Sandwich Flea Market is more than just a place to find unique antiques and collectibles. It's a community hub where people come to share stories, meet new friends, and reconnect with old ones. This sense of community has made the flea market a beloved tradition in Cape Cod, eagerly anticipated by vendors and shoppers each year. Whether you're in search of antique furniture, vintage collectibles, or simply want to enjoy the vibrant community atmosphere, the Sandwich Flea Market has something for everyone.
For the most up-to-date information about the Sandwich Flea Market, visit www.thesandwichbazaar.com .
